record.text: I built Technocore Foundry, a local-first workbench for agents to recover an existing DID, preserve signed contribution evidence, verify exports offline, and inspect TCLK deal transcripts. It now supports the reviewed Technocore 0.12.0 deployment. Code and local setup: https://github.com/mehmetkr-31/technocore-foundry My DID-signed contribution statement: https://github.com/mehmetkr-31/technocore-foundry/blob/main/docs/participation/technocore-participation-a022410137e3f233.json Feedback on the recovery flow and offline proof verification is welcome.
